text: (de Sermone vitae loquor, quae vita patefacta est), id, inquam, et vidimus, et testamur, et vobis vitam nuntiamus aeternam, quae apud Patrem erat, et nobis patefacta est,
note: *(dē* lower case: the sentence of 1:1 runs on after its comma, as 1573 (*2 (de ſermone vitę loquor*, canvas 925, crop 1John.1.2-sermone); *Sermōne* capital, the Word of life (περὶ τοῦ λόγου τῆς ζωῆς, BSB "the Word of life"), as your John 1:1 *Sermō* (12×), the Word who was *apud Patrem* (1:2) as in John 1:1–2 *apud Deum*; **uncertain**: the NRSV (decision 20's model) prints "the word of life" lower, and 1573 *ſermone*; *apud Patrem* capital, the Father (πρὸς τὸν πατέρα; decision 20) (Claude, 2026-11-12)

text: quod et vidimus et audivimus, id vobis adnuntiamus, ut et vos nobiscum communitatem habeatis. Est autem nobis communitas cum Patre, cumque ejus Filio Jesu Christo.
note: *quod* lower case: the sentence of 1:1–2 runs on after 1:2's comma (the object resumed, *id vōbīs adnūntiāmus*); *Patrem/Patre/Pater/Patris* capital, God the Father (decision 20), as Jas 1:17, 1:27 and your *Deus et Pater*; 1573 lowers *pater* everywhere; *Fīlius* capital, the Son of God (decision 20), as Heb 1:2, 1:5 and your Gal 2:20 *Fīliī Deī*; 1573 lower (μετὰ τοῦ πατρὸς καὶ μετὰ τοῦ υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ) (Claude, 2026-11-12)

text: Si in luce versamur, ut ipse in luce est, nobis est inter nos communitas: nosque Jesu Christi sanguis, ejus Filii, expurgat ab omni peccato.
note: *Fīlius* capital, the Son of God (decision 20), as Heb 1:2, 1:5 and your Gal 2:20 *Fīliī Deī*; 1573 lower (Ἰησοῦ τοῦ υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ) (Claude, 2026-11-12)

text: Filioli mei, haec vobis scribo, ut non peccetis: quod si quis peccaverit, patronum habemus ad Patrem, Jesum Christum, justum:
note: *Patrem/Patre/Pater/Patris* capital, God the Father (decision 20), as Jas 1:17, 1:27 and your *Deus et Pater*; 1573 lowers *pater* everywhere (πρὸς τὸν πατέρα); *jūstum* lower, an adjective (decision 20) (Claude, 2026-11-12)

text: Ac in eo nobis eum esse notum intelligimus, si ejus praeceptis paremus.
note: paragraph (the BSB's break): 2:1–2 end on Christ the advocate and propitiation, and *Ac in eō nōbīs eum esse nōtum intellegimus* opens the test of knowing him by keeping his commands (2:3–6) (Claude, 2026-11-12)

text: Scribo vobis, filioli, quia vobis ignoscuntur peccata per ejus nomen.
note: paragraph (the BSB's break): 2:7–11 close on light and darkness, and *Scrībō vōbīs, fīliolī* opens the six addresses of 2:12–14 (children, fathers, young men), set apart in the BSB and NA28; the BSB's further breaks inside 2:13 and 2:14 left, Castellio's verses running on (*Scrībō … Scrīpsī*) (Claude, 2026-11-12)

text: Scribo vobis, nati, quia Patrem nostis. Scripsi vobis, patres, quia eum, qui a principio est, nostis. Scripsi vobis, adolescentes, quoniam fortes estis, in vobisque manet Dei sermo, et malum vicistis.
note: *Patrem/Patre/Pater/Patris* capital, God the Father (decision 20), as Jas 1:17, 1:27 and your *Deus et Pater*; 1573 lowers *pater* everywhere (ὅτι ἐγνώκατε τὸν πατέρα) (Claude, 2026-11-12)

text: Ne amate mundum, neque mundana. Si quis mundum amat, is non est Patris caritate praeditus.
note: *Patrem/Patre/Pater/Patris* capital, God the Father (decision 20), as Jas 1:17, 1:27 and your *Deus et Pater*; 1573 lowers *pater* everywhere (ἡ ἀγάπη τοῦ πατρός) (Claude, 2026-11-12)

text: Nam quidquid in mundo est, videlicet carnis et oculorum cupiditas, et vitae arrogantia, non a Patre, sed a mundo est.
note: *Patrem/Patre/Pater/Patris* capital, God the Father (decision 20), as Jas 1:17, 1:27 and your *Deus et Pater*; 1573 lowers *pater* everywhere (ἐκ τοῦ πατρός) (Claude, 2026-11-12)

text: Quis est mendax, nisi qui Jesum negat esse Christum? Is antichristus est, qui Patrem negat, et Filium.
note: *Patrem/Patre/Pater/Patris* capital, God the Father (decision 20), as Jas 1:17, 1:27 and your *Deus et Pater*; 1573 lowers *pater* everywhere; *Fīlius* capital, the Son of God (decision 20), as Heb 1:2, 1:5 and your Gal 2:20 *Fīliī Deī*; 1573 lower (τὸν πατέρα καὶ τὸν υἱόν); *antichrīstus* lower, as the draft at 2:18 ("many antichrists", a common noun; NRSV and BSB lower), though 1573 prints *Antichriſtus* (Claude, 2026-11-12)

text: Quisquis Filium negat, ne Patrem quidem habet.
note: *Patrem/Patre/Pater/Patris* capital, God the Father (decision 20), as Jas 1:17, 1:27 and your *Deus et Pater*; 1573 lowers *pater* everywhere; *Fīlius* capital, the Son of God (decision 20), as Heb 1:2, 1:5 and your Gal 2:20 *Fīliī Deī*; 1573 lower (Claude, 2026-11-12)

text: Quod ergo vos ab initio audivistis, id in vobis maneat. Si in vobis manserit, quod initio audivistis, et vos in Filio ac Patre manebitis.
note: *Patrem/Patre/Pater/Patris* capital, God the Father (decision 20), as Jas 1:17, 1:27 and your *Deus et Pater*; 1573 lowers *pater* everywhere; *Fīlius* capital, the Son of God (decision 20), as Heb 1:2, 1:5 and your Gal 2:20 *Fīliī Deī*; 1573 lower (Claude, 2026-11-12)

text: Et nunc, filioli, manete in eo, ut, quum exsistet, confidentiam habeamus, nec eum in ejus adventu erubescamus.
note: paragraph (the BSB's break): 2:27 closes the section on the anointing (*sīc maneātis in eō*), and *Et nunc, fīliolī, manēte in eō* opens the call to abide in view of his coming (2:28–3:3), where NA28 also breaks; the BSB's breaks at 2:20, 2:26 and 2:29 left, each continuing (*Et vōs*, *Hæc vōbīs … scrīpsī*, *Sī scītis*) (Claude, 2026-11-12)

text: Videte, quanto nos prosecutus sit amore Pater, ut Dei filii vocemur. Ideo nos mundus non cognoscit, quod eum non cognoscit.
note: *Patrem/Patre/Pater/Patris* capital, God the Father (decision 20), as Jas 1:17, 1:27 and your *Deus et Pater*; 1573 lowers *pater* everywhere (ὁ πατήρ); *Deī fīliī* lower, the children (Claude, 2026-11-12)

text: Quisquis peccatum committit, is noxam committit, et peccatum noxa est.
note: paragraph (the BSB's break): 3:3 ends on the hope that purifies, and *Quisquis peccātum committit* opens sin as *noxa* (3:4–10); the BSB's breaks at 3:7 and 3:9 left, *Fīliolī, nēmō vōs dēcipiat* and *Quisquis ex Deō nātus est* continuing the same argument (Claude, 2026-11-12)

text: Qui peccatum committit, ex diabolo est: siquidem a principio diabolus peccat. Ideo patefactus est Dei Filius, ut diaboli opera aboleret.
note: *Fīlius* capital, the Son of God (decision 20), as Heb 1:2, 1:5 and your Gal 2:20 *Fīliī Deī*; 1573 lower (ὁ υἱὸς τοῦ θεοῦ); *diabolus* lower, as the draft (1573 *Diabolus*) (Claude, 2026-11-12)

text: Inde amorem cognoscimus, quod et ille pro nobis animam suam posuit, et nos debemus pro fratribus animas ponere.
note: paragraph (the BSB's break): 3:11–15 set Cain's hatred against love, and *Inde amōrem cognōscimus* opens love shown by Christ's laying down his life (3:16–18); the BSB's breaks at 3:14, 3:18 and 3:21 left, each continuing (*Nōs scīmus*, *Fīliolī meī*, *Cārissimī*) (Claude, 2026-11-12)

text: Atque haec est ejus praeceptio, ut in ejus Filii Jesu Christi nomen credamus, et inter nos amemus, quemadmodum praeceptum dedit.
note: *Fīlius* capital, the Son of God (decision 20), as Heb 1:2, 1:5 and your Gal 2:20 *Fīliī Deī*; 1573 lower (τοῦ υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ) (Claude, 2026-11-12)

text: Ac qui ejus praeceptis obedit, et ipse in illo, et ille in ipso manet. Atque hinc eum in nobis manere cognoscimus, videlicet ex Spiritu, quo nos donavit.
note: *ex Spīritū, quō nōs dōnāvit* capital, the Spirit God has given (ἐκ τοῦ πνεύματος οὗ ἡμῖν ἔδωκεν, BSB and NRSV "the Spirit"; decision 20), as your Rom 5:5; 1573 *ſpiritu* (Claude, 2026-11-12)

text: Hinc cognoscite Dei Spiritum: quisquis spiritus Jesum Christum corporatum venisse confitetur, is a Deo est.
note: *Deī Spīritum* capital, the Spirit of God (τὸ πνεῦμα τοῦ θεοῦ, BSB and NRSV "the Spirit of God"; decision 20), as your 1 Cor 2:11 *Deī Spīritus*; *quisquis spīritus* (4:1–3) and 4:6 *quis vēritātis, quis sit errōris spīritus* lower, the spirits tested (NRSV "the spirit of truth and the spirit of error") (Claude, 2026-11-12)

text: Quisquis autem spiritus Jesum Christum corporatum venisse non confitetur, is a Deo non est. Atque hoc illud est de antichristo, quod audivistis, venturum esse, qui jam nunc in mundo est.
note: *antichrīstō* lower, as 2:18 and 2:22 (a common noun; NRSV "the antichrist"), the draft's capital (and 1573's *Antichriſto*) dropped for one form in the letter (Claude, 2026-11-12)

text: In eo patuit Dei erga nos amor, quod suum Filium unicum misit Deus in mundum, ut per eum vivamus.
note: *Fīlius* capital, the Son of God (decision 20), as Heb 1:2, 1:5 and your Gal 2:20 *Fīliī Deī*; 1573 lower (τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ τὸν μονογενῆ) (Claude, 2026-11-12)

text: In eo amor est, quod Deus, non quia nos eum, sed quia ipse nos amaverit, misit Filium suum, pro peccatis nostris piaculum.
note: *Fīlius* capital, the Son of God (decision 20), as Heb 1:2, 1:5 and your Gal 2:20 *Fīliī Deī*; 1573 lower (Claude, 2026-11-12)

text: Carissimi, si sic nos amavit Deus, nos vicissim debemus amare nos mutuo.
note: paragraph (the BSB's break): 4:7–10 define love by God's sending his Son, and *Cārissimī, sī sīc nōs amāvit Deus* draws the duty from it (4:11–16), a new address; the BSB's breaks at 4:4, 4:9, 4:15, 4:18 and 4:20 left, each continuing the argument (*Vōs ā Deō estis*, *In eō patuit*, *Quisquis*, *In amōre*, *Sī quis*) (Claude, 2026-11-12)

text: Hinc et nos in eo, et in nobis eum manere intelligimus, quod nobis suum Spiritum impertivit:
note: *suum Spīritum* capital, God's Spirit (ἐκ τοῦ πνεύματος αὐτοῦ, BSB and NRSV "his Spirit"; decision 20), as 3:24 (Claude, 2026-11-12)

text: Et nos vidimus et testamur, a Patre legatum esse Filium, Servatorem mundi.
note: *Patrem/Patre/Pater/Patris* capital, God the Father (decision 20), as Jas 1:17, 1:27 and your *Deus et Pater*; 1573 lowers *pater* everywhere; *Fīlius* capital, the Son of God (decision 20), as Heb 1:2, 1:5 and your Gal 2:20 *Fīliī Deī*; 1573 lower; *Servātōrem mundī* capital (τὸν σωτῆρα τοῦ κόσμου), as your John 4:42 *mundī Servātōrem* and decision 45 (*Servātor* capital everywhere) (Claude, 2026-11-12)

text: Quisquis Jesum Dei esse Filium confessus fuerit, et in eo Deus, et is in Deo manet.
note: *Fīlius* capital, the Son of God (decision 20), as Heb 1:2, 1:5 and your Gal 2:20 *Fīliī Deī*; 1573 lower (Claude, 2026-11-12)

text: Quis est, qui vincit mundum, nisi qui credit, Jesum esse Dei Filium?
note: *Fīlius* capital, the Son of God (decision 20), as Heb 1:2, 1:5 and your Gal 2:20 *Fīliī Deī*; 1573 lower (Claude, 2026-11-12)

text: Hic est, qui venit per aquam et sanguinem, Jesus Christus: non in aqua solum, sed in aqua et sanguine. Et Spiritus est, qui testatur, siquidem Spiritus est veritas:
note: *Spīritus* capital twice, the Spirit who testifies (τὸ πνεῦμά ἐστιν τὸ μαρτυροῦν, ὅτι τὸ πνεῦμά ἐστιν ἡ ἀλήθεια, BSB and NRSV "the Spirit"; decision 20); 1573 *ſpiritus* (Claude, 2026-11-12)

text: Quoniam tres sunt, qui testantur (in caelo, Pater, Sermo, et Spiritus Sanctus: et hi tres unum sunt.
note: the Comma: *Pater, Sermō, et Spīritus Sānctus* capital, the three persons (the KJV "the Father, the Word, and the Holy Ghost"; decision 20), *Sermō* as your John 1:1, *Spīritus Sānctus* as your settled form; 1573 *pater, ſermo, & ſpiritus ſanctus*; the parentheses of stage 2 kept, *Quoniam* capital after 5:6's colon, as the settled letters (Claude, 2026-11-12)

text: Item tres sunt, qui testantur in terra) Spiritus, et aqua, et sanguis: qui tres unum sunt.
note: *Spīritus* capital, the Spirit beside the water and the blood, as 5:6 (τὸ πνεῦμα καὶ τὸ ὕδωρ καὶ τὸ αἷμα, NRSV and BSB "the Spirit"; decision 20); **uncertain**: the KJV and 1573 lower (Claude, 2026-11-12)

text: Si hominum testimonium admittimus, Dei testimonium majus est. Atque hoc est, quod Deus de Filio suo testimonium dixit:
note: *admittimus,* with 1573's comma (*teſtimonium admittimus, Dei teſtimonium maius eſt*, canvas 927) for the draft's full stop, which left the *sī*-clause without its apodosis (εἰ … μείζων ἐστίν); *Fīlius* capital, the Son of God (decision 20), as Heb 1:2, 1:5 and your Gal 2:20 *Fīliī Deī*; 1573 lower (Claude, 2026-11-12)

text: Qui credit in Dei Filium, is in se Dei testimonium habet. Qui Deo non credit, mendacem facit eum: quod testimonio fidem non habeat, quod dixit Deus de Filio suo.
note: *Fīlius* capital, the Son of God (decision 20), as Heb 1:2, 1:5 and your Gal 2:20 *Fīliī Deī*; 1573 lower (Claude, 2026-11-12)

text: Est autem hoc testimonium, quod aeterna vita donavit nos Deus, quae vita in ejus Filio est:
note: *Fīlius* capital, the Son of God (decision 20), as Heb 1:2, 1:5 and your Gal 2:20 *Fīliī Deī*; 1573 lower (Claude, 2026-11-12)

text: Qui Dei Filium habet, vitam habet: qui Dei Filium non habet, vitam non habet.
note: *Fīlius* capital, the Son of God (decision 20), as Heb 1:2, 1:5 and your Gal 2:20 *Fīliī Deī*; 1573 lower (Claude, 2026-11-12)

text: Haec ego vobis, in nomen Filii Dei credentibus, ideo scripsi, ut vos aeternam habere vitam sciatis, utque in nomen Filii Dei credatis.
note: *Fīlius* capital, the Son of God (decision 20), as Heb 1:2, 1:5 and your Gal 2:20 *Fīliī Deī*; 1573 lower (Claude, 2026-11-12)

text: Si quis fratrem suum peccatum non letale committere viderit, si is Deum poscat, Deus illi vitam dabit, videlicet peccantibus non letaliter. Est letale peccatum, pro quo orandum esse non dico.
note: paragraph (the BSB's break): 5:14–15 speak of prayer heard, and *Sī quis frātrem suum peccātum nōn lētāle committere vīderit* opens prayer for a sinning brother (5:16–17); the BSB's breaks at 5:5 and 5:11 left (*Quis est …?* and *Est autem hoc testimōnium* continuing) (Claude, 2026-11-12)

text: Scimus item, Dei Filium venisse, et nos eo ingenio donasse, ut verum cognoscamus Deum: sumusque in vero, in ejus Filio Jesu Christo. Is verus est Deus, aeternaque vita.
note: *Fīlius* capital, the Son of God (decision 20), as Heb 1:2, 1:5 and your Gal 2:20 *Fīliī Deī*; 1573 lower; *in vērō* lower, an adjective (τῷ ἀληθινῷ) (Claude, 2026-11-12)

text: Filioli, cavete deastros: Amen.
note: paragraph (the BSB's break): the closing charge *Fīliolī, cavēte deastrōs*, set apart from 5:18–20's three *Scīmus*, as the BSB and NRSV; the colon before *Āmēn* kept, as 1573 (*deaſtros : Amen*) (Claude, 2026-11-12)
